policy.objective: Reduce end-to-end journey time on service 265 without new vehicles
policy.text: Remove the two stops on Ang Mo Kio Avenue 3 from bus service 265 and run the service express between the interchange and Ave 8, without increasing the fleet.

reading.claim: Two stops are removed from service 265
reading.why: Named explicitly: the two on Ang Mo Kio Avenue 3.

reading.claim: The express segment runs interchange to Ave 8

reading.why: Derived from the skipped dwell time at two stops plus the faster running. Not stated in the policy; assumed.
The text says without increasing the fleet, so any option needing new vehicles is out of scope.
The policy does not mention it. Assumed to keep running as today.

interventions.name: Retain both stops at peak
interventions.rationale: Keep the express saving off-peak and give the corridor back during the commute.

interventions.name: Clinic shuttle on the affected corridor
interventions.rationale: A small vehicle linking the two removed stops to the polyclinic and the interchange, sized for the trips the policy actually broke.

interventions.name: Reroute service 162 onto the corridor
interventions.rationale: No new vehicles. The feeder covers the affected corridor instead of the eastern loop.

interventions.name: Assisted transport for clinic-dependent residents

params.eligible: mobility-limited with an essential clinic trip

interventions.rationale: Door-to-door booking for the residents whose walk the policy pushed past what they can manage.

interventions.name: Full shuttle network, 10-minute headway
interventions.rationale: Cover every subzone at commuter frequency.
validation_errors: operating cost index 1.34 exceeds the declared ceiling of 1.08
requires additional vehicles; the policy declares no fleet increase

discovered_constraint.source: consultation free-text, corroborated by the cohort error
discovered_constraint.note: The covered walkway ends partway and there is a slope. The model costed the distance and not the walk, so it over-predicted support here and nowhere else.

threshold_cliff.name: Threshold cliff
threshold_cliff.mechanism: A limit is crossed and the service stops being usable, rather than simply getting worse. Averages miss this because the mean moves smoothly while individuals fall off an edge.

dependency_cascade.name: Dependency cascade
dependency_cascade.mechanism: Harm lands on someone the policy never touched, because they absorb the loss for a person who depends on them. They are invisible to any analysis that looks only at who uses the service.

capacity_displacement.name: Capacity displacement
capacity_displacement.mechanism: Relief for one group creates load somewhere else. The total looks unchanged or improved while a different population quietly absorbs the difference.

participation_gap.name: Participation gap
participation_gap.mechanism: The people most affected are the least able to respond to a consultation, so the feedback that arrives systematically understates the harm.
